name: doom-pane
description: The original DOOM in a pane with nothing to install: id's engine (doomgeneric, GPL-2) compiled to JavaScript runs inside the mod, Freedoom Phase 1 ships with the plugin, the picture is half-block pixels on a Raster. /doom opens it; w a s d move, q e strafe, f fires, u uses, m opens the menu. Your own IWAD plays too, split into 2 MiB parts. Saves live in the plugin store.

wadDir.title: WAD folder
wadDir.description: Folder holding one sub-folder per prepared IWAD (manifest.json + part-NNN.bin, written by tools/prepare-wad.mjs). Empty: ~/.claude/doom-wads.

alwaysRun.title: Always run
alwaysRun.description: Hold the run key for you (the terminal has no Shift hotkey). Default: on.

maxFps.title: Frames per second
maxFps.description: At most this many frames a second to the terminal (1-35); the game itself runs at 35 tics. A large view is paced further so the terminal keeps up. Default: 20.

maxCells.title: View cell cap
maxCells.description: At most this many Raster cells for the picture (columns x rows); empty: as many as the pane holds, up to 512x256. Lower it if the pane refuses a large tree or the frame rate drops.
